Implemented on branch `f321-skill-sandbox-rule`; pushed as Gerrit change 2270 (commit fb3c4ccf96ba). Not closing — awaiting LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1.

Both `rebar-debug` (Step 5 mutation check) and `rebar-implement` (4e give-the-tests-teeth) now carry an identical inline "Sandbox the mutation run — the seeded defect is arbitrary code" block: hostile-code framing citing the 2026-08-26 `rm -rf /*` outcome, the complete macOS `sandbox-exec` snippet with its self-written heredoc profile, the complete Linux `bwrap --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --proc /proc --bind "$PWD" "$PWD"` argv, the `bwrap --ro-bind / / -- /bin/true` capability probe with both observed AppArmor failure strings, and the no-sandbox injected-seam fallback ("do not proceed unsandboxed"). Each mutation bullet gained a one-line pointer marking it mandatory. Nothing weakened — the block closes by restating that RED-first, held-out oracle and mutation teeth are unchanged.

New `tests/scripts/test_skill_mutation_sandbox_rule.py` (15 tests, parametrized over both skills) asserts every literal group. RED proof: reverting `rebar-debug/SKILL.md` alone → 7 failed / 8 passed; reverting `rebar-implement/SKILL.md` alone → 6 failed / 9 passed; both restored → 15 passed.

Gates green: `make lint` 0, `make typecheck` 0 (676 files), `check_skill_frontmatter.py` 0 (4 skills valid), `check_import_walk.py` 0, and 96 passed across every full test module that reads the skills.
